output.reason: One month of stress-related sleep-onset difficulty with preserved function and no reported red-flag features can start with sleep-hygiene guidance and self-observation, with clinician review if it persists or worsens.
output.patientMessage: You can start now with sleep-hygiene steps: consistent bed and wake times, no caffeine in the afternoon or evening, no screens or alcohol before bed, a cool dark quiet room, and if you're awake 20 minutes get up and do something relaxing. Stress-related sleep-onset trouble often improves this way. Message us if it continues past a few more weeks, you start dozing off while driving, or low mood or loss of interest appears.
